description: This file is a PHP source file that generates a web page listing test cases without an assigned tester in a test management system. It includes functions for initializing parameters, building data tables, and creating UI components. The script interacts with database objects and utilizes templating for rendering the output.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class representing external table components used to display structured test case data.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: A class managing test plan data and related operations.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: A class for handling hierarchical path structures of test cases.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class representing test projects, including options and configurations.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A templating class used for rendering HTML pages.

methods.name: buildTable
methods.description: Constructs a data table object for displaying test cases without testers, including styling and behavior options.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves request parameters and related test plan information.

methods.name: featureLinks
methods.description: Generates HTML links with icons for different test case features like execution history and editing.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with page titles, labels, and project information for rendering.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies user permissions for accessing test plan metrics.
